about.title: About NgDigest
about.lead: The Angular tech watch that aggregates the best articles, tutorials and community news — every week.
about.howItWorks.title: How does it work?
about.howItWorks.text: NgDigest connects to multiple sources to automatically collect the most relevant Angular content. It currently uses SerpAPI for web search and the dev.to API for community articles. More API integrations will be added over time to bring you the most complete Angular ecosystem coverage.
